name: 透
text: なんか、みんなすごく上手くなってるよね
trans: They're all getting really good, aren't they?

name: 透
text:
──ダンスの話
二週間後ダンスレッスンしたいんだけど
trans:
──At dance. I'd like to take dance lessons in two 
weeks, if that's okay.

name: 透
text:
あ、いいの？
ふふっ、ありがと

name: 透
text:
あ、うん。わかってたよ
……ごめんね、急に
trans:
Ah, okay. Got it.
...Sorry for asking out of nowhere.
